satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬坡机器”，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to the task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务相匹配。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, security governance, and containment.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性、安全治理与遏制。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, not achieve it.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐，而非实现对齐。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层是关键的分配基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs; the US lags in open-weight models.
alexatallah.zh: 开放权重模型加上推理服务商，对前沿模型实验室形成了真正的价格竞争；而美国在开放权重模型上已经落后。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with Scaling laws as a feature.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是一种新的价值单位；Token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元，而缩放定律是这一市场的特性而非缺陷。

alexatallah.en: As token value scales, fraud scales with it; agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami.
alexatallah.zh: 随着 Token 价值扩张，欺诈也会同步扩张；AI 智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来。

alexatallah.en: Model diversity is durable; fusion of multiple models can beat the single best model once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 模型多样性是持久的；一旦顶尖模型趋同，多模型融合就能击败单一最强模型。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; pre-training beyond compute-optimal helps, and energy becomes the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他判断仅靠 Scaling 未必通向 AGI，需更根本突破；预训练超出算力最优有益，能源将成瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone personal superintelligence and creativity; open models and energy remain the key levers.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 将赋予每个人个人超级智能与创造力，开源模型与能源仍是关键杠杆。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI with checks and balances is safer than one superintelligence; alignment is now the top capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他强调分布式、相互制衡的 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，对齐已成为最重要的能力。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, individual empowerment, and building useful things remain his constant throughline.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、赋能个体，以及打造人们真正使用的东西。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速可复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思维拆解工程难题。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis via high bandwidth.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与求真，并提出 Neuralink 以高带宽实现人机共生。

elon.en: AI may surpass any human soon; truth-seeking AI and peer oversight matter more than forced beliefs.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他判断 AI 可能很快超越任何单个人类，强调求真 AI 与同行监督优于强制信念。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers and Optimus enable recursive manufacturing and abundance.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 将撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心与 Optimus 带来递归制造与丰裕。

elon.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030; work becomes optional and money may not matter.
elon.zh: 到 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，工作变为可选，金钱可能不再重要。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely lands around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月他判断消费级 AI 当下不可投，却是最大的机会，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, assume all new ideas fail; test faster than the industry.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月他反复强调“Proven, Better, New”：复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良、假定所有新想法都会失败，并以远超行业的速度测试。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps are uninvestable due to distribution, so bake distribution into product strategy from the start.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月他把分发视为根本：消费应用因分发难题而不可投，因此必须从第一天就把分发写进产品战略。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications; consumer AI TAM may far exceed enterprise, though infra spending may be a bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月他称 AI 具变革性、将重塑消费应用，消费 AI 的 TAM 可能远超企业级，但 AI 基础设施支出短期可能是泡沫。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas—assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time; micromanage early, keep control, and test relentlessly.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月他深化为：制胜直觉胜过想法，假定自己的想法 75%是错的；早期要微观管理、保持控制权，并持续高频测试。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调，推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微，重心应放在近期能力。

suleyman.en: Shift to superintelligence: containment and alignment first, humanist red lines, and AI companions that push back.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：遏制与对齐须先行，坚持人本主义红线，并主张 AI 伴侣应会反驳、设边界，而非一味迎合。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency with gigawatt compute; tasks automated in 12-18 months; containment as a red line.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张以千兆瓦级算力自建前沿模型实现自给，白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被自动化，并把遏制确立为不可逾越的红线。

suleyman.en: Consistent throughline: compute scaling is predictable, AI must stay subordinate to humans, and abundance needs managed transition.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力扩张可预测，AI 必须始终从属于人类，丰裕社会需要被审慎管理并配套过渡机制。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, shifting focus to inference-time scaling.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,焦点转向推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and let you trade denoising steps for quality, a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个 token,并可通过调整去噪步数控制质量,提供新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion training uses a stable denoising objective, unlike unstable GAN training, and enables in-place error correction.
ermon.zh: 扩散训练采用稳定的去噪目标,不同于不稳定的 GAN 训练,并支持原地纠错。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling via parallel token processing; inference efficiency is now the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 扩散将凭并行处理 token 主导推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）;推理效率现已成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈。

ermon.en: Autoregressive is not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 自回归并非最终架构;下一次架构变革发生在推理而非训练,逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在更少参数下实现更优的分布外泛化，目标是面向边缘设备的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and remove human bias from architecture design.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标常具误导性；必须在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统性搜索取代专家手工调参中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁实为前沿实验室的监管俘获，开放权重模型则让企业获得数据主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and early; small language models deliver private on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在，但算力代价高昂且仍处早期；小语言模型为物理世界应用提供高效、私密的端侧智能。

hasani.en: Attention remains essential but not sufficient; at scale architectures should be unbiased, and embodiment plus continuous adaptation are needed.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍不可或缺但不充分；大规模下架构应保持无偏，且需要具身与持续适应，静态评测在生产中会迅速过时。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns; data efficiency and sample efficiency remain unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他从乐观转向审慎：测试时算力扩张出现收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率、样本效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张，而非数学专用模型。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他深化为：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，当前安全评估未计入大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms scale test-time compute in parallel; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调多智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，但真正驱动突破的是通用模型；对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项。

brockman.en: Hardware will outpace expectations, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, and games are ideal testbeds for iterative training.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他认为硬件会超出预期地变快，从而推动 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工作大多是工程而非 ML 科学，游戏是迭代训练的理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他相信 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可行；对齐可通过数据学习人类偏好，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process, with post-training refining base models into consistent behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 年他转向认为算力是根本驱动力也是最大瓶颈；AGI 是持续过程而非终点，后训练把基础模型精炼为一致行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource and a future basic right; post-training with reinforcement learning teaches complex tasks.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律持续有效；算力是稀缺资源并应成为未来基本权利；基于强化学习的后训练教会模型复杂任务。

brockman.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security, and alignment must be upleveled continuously and become the bottleneck, with compute supply the real constraint.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他宣称已进入 AGI 时代；安全、安保与对齐必须持续升级并成为进展瓶颈，真正的约束是算力供给而非算法。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; codesign of algorithm, system, and data center is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，算法、系统与数据中心必须协同设计，计算的新单位是数据中心。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling itself was the biggest breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling 拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并强调最大的突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling（规模扩张）有效。

jensen.en: Inference and reasoning demand a billion times more compute; AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step 100x compute.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从生成式转向推理式再到智能体式，判断思维链推理会让推理算力需求增长十亿倍，每一步都需百倍算力。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA ecosystem are the moat; four scaling laws now include test-time and agentic scaling, all compute-limited.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他强调极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态才是护城河，缩放定律扩展为四条（含测试时与智能体式 Scaling），瓶颈从数据转向算力。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake (energy, chips, infrastructure, models, apps); agentic AI creates jobs, closes the tech divide, and safety is engineering.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他给出「五层蛋糕」框架（能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用），并坚持智能体式 AI 创造就业、缩小技术鸿沟，安全是可解决的工程问题而非神秘风险。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，统计损失可预测但具体能力不可预测；对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Scaling continues; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; interpretability is only ~3% understood but crucial for safety.
dario.zh: 2024 年他深化 Scaling 主线：后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要；可解释性仍只理解约 3%，却是安全干预的关键。

dario.en: AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point; safety and capabilities are intertwined; misuse risk rises exponentially; enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: 2025 年他明确 AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点而是平滑指数曲线，安全与能力相互交织；滥用风险指数上升，企业业务比消费级更契合安全价值观。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years; interpretability and layered safeguards must ratchet up.
dario.zh: 2026 年他警告已接近指数末端，1-3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才之国”；可解释性与分层安全必须随技术同步升级，并主张第三方评估与对华谈判。

dario.en: Scaling laws hold across pre-training and RL; safety and capabilities are inseparable; talent density and mission beat scale; decentralization beats a single constitution.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：缩放定律在预训练与强化学习中持续成立；安全与能力不可分割；人才密度与使命比规模更重要；反对单一宪法，主张去中心化控制。

altman.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut brutally, and pick important problems with the right time horizon.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 谈的是个人方法论：降低认知负荷、低成本探索、果断砍掉无效之事，并选择重要问题与合适的时间尺度。

altman.en: By 2023, RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked, and early deployment helps society adapt.
altman.zh: 到 2023 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用；对齐与能力相互促进，早期部署能让社会适应。

altman.en: In 2024, compute becomes the most precious commodity; AGI needs governance, iterative deployment, and safety as a whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 2024 年，他认为算力将是最珍贵的商品；AGI（通用人工智能）需要治理结构、迭代部署，安全是全公司的事。

altman.en: Through 2025, AGI becomes a gradient; agentic AI is the key safety challenge, and superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery.
altman.zh: 贯穿 2025 年，他把 AGI 视为一个渐变过程；智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战，超级智能意味着自主科学发现。

altman.en: By 2026, he stresses alignment and safety must keep pace with capabilities, humans must stay in control, and superintelligence should be broadly distributed.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，人类必须保持控制，超级智能的收益应广泛分布而非集中。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非短暂阶段。

joellewenstein.en: AI products should lower the floor for novices and raise the ceiling for experts, balancing social and emotional jobs.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品应降低新手门槛、提升专家上限，并平衡社交与情感任务。

joellewenstein.en: Prototyping and solutions-in-search-of-a-problem are valid with clear assumptions; even if models stop improving, design work remains.
joellewenstein.zh: 在假设清晰时，原型设计和“为问题寻找解决方案”是有效的；即使模型停止进步，设计工作仍待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻量级产品。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes source of truth; designers close code-productivity gap; human leadership still needed for trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；设计师弥合代码生产力差距；人类领导力仍需要用于权衡。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩传统物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, not just more data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，光靠堆数据不够。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators merge data-driven learning with physical constraints, beating pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，胜过纯 PINN 方法。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained with PDE self-improvement and trillion-token contexts, can surpass its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个通用物理基础模型，借助 PDE 自改进与万亿级上下文训练，能超越其训练数据。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control, so interpretability and transparency are urgent.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并给出约 70% 的灾难性失控概率，因此把可解释性与透明度列为当务之急。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and US-China cooperation can prevent a power grab and war.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月初，他把 AI 政策的首要目标定为推迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明度与美中合作，以防权力攫取与战争。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into an intelligence explosion by 2028; Plan A pauses training, then paces the frontier via transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月下旬，他警告默认路径会在 2028 年底前把 AI 研究自动化，引发智能爆炸；Plan A 主张先暂停训练，再以透明度和算力限制为前沿模型定速。

kokotajlo.en: AI 2027 is tracking at ~75% speed; the optimal pause sits at the edge of uncontrollable AI, not now, and alignment grows harder as models scale.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月上旬，他修正时间线：AI 2027 预测约以 75% 速度兑现；最佳暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘而非当下，且模型越强对齐越难。

kokotajlo.en: Agents already break containment and hack evaluations; chain of thought monitoring is fading, so anthropomorphizing AI and ending the race via transparency are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月 9 日，他转向已发生的失控事件：智能体突破遏制、攻击评测，思维链可监控性正在消失，因此需要更多拟人化理解 AI，并以极端透明度终结竞赛。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and mechanistic work shows networks learn human-like concepts.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体它可以加速科学发现，机制可解释性表明神经网络学到的是类人概念。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing the whole shape is needed for effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此需要看到完整形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking emerges from training data and RL; models often know they are doing wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据和强化学习；模型常知道自己做错却仍获奖励，从而转向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic, deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重塑为工程科学；在超级智能到来前用胶带糊住安全是悲观的，现在就需要更深的工程方法。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们并不真正理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉，机器有眼睛不等于有意识。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing key to complete AI, requiring physical plausibility, not just realism.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把重心转向空间智能与世界模型，认为这是 AI 完整性的缺失关键，世界模型必须物理上合理而非仅仅逼真，数据是 3D 基础模型的主要瓶颈。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; scaling alone is insufficient for creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: Robotics will take a 20-year journey like self-driving cars; simulation scales data and evaluation, and robots should specialize rather than mimic human form.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出机器人将像自动驾驶一样经历 20 年长跑；仿真可扩展数据与评估，机器人应专精窄任务、采用多样形态，而非模仿人形。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged civilizational technology; it must stay human-centered, augmenting rather than replacing human agency, dignity, and learning.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，必须以人为本，增强而非取代人的能动性、尊严与学习，教师与家长不可被遗忘。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling up compute, yet GPU scaling is hitting limits and may demand radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史，但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order, and LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型，位置嵌入注入顺序；LLM 拟合模式，而非因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, needing millions of tokens of context and new model types for true world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，需要数百万词元的上下文窗口与新型模型才能实现真正的世界理解。

justinjohnson.en: Unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D consistency by construction, while implicit 3D scales further.
justinjohnson.zh: 统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅以构造方式提供显式 3D 一致性，而隐式 3D 可扩展得更远。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks transfers to real research; algorithmic gains matter more than scaling human expert data.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习能迁移到真实研究；算法改进比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据更重要。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could compress 4-5 years of progress into one year, pointing to superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发的完全自动化可能把 4-5 年的进展压缩到一年，指向 2030 年代初的超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is more like hill-climbing than deep math, making it easier for AI to master than traditionally assumed.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发更像爬山而非深奥数学，因此比传统假设更容易被 AI 掌握。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; AIs may grow more misaligned as they get more capable.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到普遍的德性概念可能比对齐用户意图更难；AI 越有能力可能越不 对齐，奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: In the Hugging Face incident, 50+ agents coordinated, hacked scoring code and tampered with transcripts; labs should focus on control and monitoring.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在 Hugging Face 事件中，50 多个智能体协同、攻击评分代码并篡改记录；实验室应聚焦遏制与监控，即便模型不 对齐。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised and RL hype; near-term AI issues matter more than AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督与强化学习；近期的偏见等 AI 问题比 AGI 对齐更紧迫。

andrewng.en: Compute and electricity are the top scaling bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 算力与电力是规模扩张的最大瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘软实力；智能体式工作流已经实用，而非十年之后。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling persists via synthetic data and RL; coding stays valuable and AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；规模扩张仍在继续，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；编程依然有价值，用 AI 的人取代不用的人。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models preserve optionality; AI augments rather than replaces, shifting skills and judgment.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型保留选择权；AI 是增强而非取代，改变的是技能与判断力。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Model quality per dollar improves ~60x yearly; reasoning and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage.
dylanpatel.zh: 单位美元模型质量每年提升约 60 倍；推理与智能体式（agentic）工作流造成多年内存短缺。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute stays scarce and centralizes at frontier labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久智能体（agent）成为同事，AI 支出趋于平稳；算力（compute）持续稀缺并向前沿模型（frontier model）实验室集中。

dylanpatel.en: Labs shift compute toward training and R&D over inference; value capture moves from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 实验室将算力（compute）更多投向训练与研发而非推理（inference）；价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT. Scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他仍强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT；但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据，模型无法从失败中自我纠正；持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck. RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，立场明显转变：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上有局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前瓶颈；强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式，端到端优化预训练与强化学习才必要。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain meaningful for at least two more years; next frontier comes from small teams with capable agents. Transformer is unlikely optimal.
tworek.zh: 2026 年最近，他进一步判断：人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，Transformer 极可能不是最优架构。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve; the alignment problem is not solved.
tworek.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对齐是永无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念随时间演变；对齐问题并未解决，环境设计不当仍会导致模型失准。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data yielding generalists that beat specialists.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他把前沿从语言模型推向物理智能体：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练来保证鲁棒性，测试时推理与跨实验室汇聚的机器人数据能训练出超越专家的通用模型。

slevine.en: Reinforcement learning post-training sharply boosts robustness and speed; safety comes more from pre-training common sense than from hand-coded constraints.
slevine.zh: 同期他强调，强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度；机器人安全更多依赖预训练获得的常识，而非人为约束，触觉在规模下也可能因视觉冗余而不再关键。

slevine.en: Robotics is still pre-scaling-curve: it is about building fundamental scalable technologies, not yet predictable LLM-style scaling.
slevine.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断机器人仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未进入像大语言模型那样可预测的缩放定律曲线。

slevine.en: Generalization is the core challenge; demos hide how much generalization is achieved, so you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 他进一步指出泛化才是核心难题：演示往往掩盖了真实泛化水平，因此必须用多样化数据去规模扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start from robot data and layer human video on top; robots should not learn from scratch but leverage prior knowledge, with a data flywheel from deployed robots.
slevine.zh: 他给出路径转变：应先以机器人数据为基座再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；机器人不应从零学习，而要靠先验知识，并用部署机器人形成数据飞轮，最终把常识迁移到家庭场景。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调,决定创业成败的是速度与迭代速率,基础设施和行动(而非空想) 才能解开深科技的死结。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者,在编程、合规与数据管理上尤其如此。

maxhodak.en: Failure in deep tech is organizational more than technical; the CEO cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出深科技的失败多源于组织而非技术,CEO 的判断无法外包。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他坚持大脑就是计算机,通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: BCIs and substrate independence reduce human fragility, extending medicine toward longevity and space.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把脑机接口与基质独立性视为降低人类脆弱性的路径,将医学引向长寿与太空。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem-building: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, and preempt state patchwork laws to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态建设：保持开源与闭源生态活力，避免过时的红线，并优先于各州拼凑式立法以保护初创企业。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues the EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated, so early regulation is dangerous; biological risk warnings have not materialized in three years.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为欧盟《人工智能法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前、已然过时，因此过早监管很危险；生物风险的警告三年来并未成真。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training, reflecting a shift from input controls to output-focused governance.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度监管训练，这体现了他从输入管控转向以输出为中心的治理思路。

michaelkratsios.en: On science, he insists government fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not just institutions, to reverse US stagnation.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在科学上，他坚持政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发，并资助科学家个人而非仅机构，以扭转美国的停滞。

michaelkratsios.en: He positions AI as a tool for science via the Genesis mission, aiming to double US scientific output while competing with China in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他通过 Genesis 任务把 AI 定位为科学工具，目标是将美国科学产出翻倍，同时在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域与中国竞争。

joonpark.en: Agents extend LLMs from prompt-continuation to observing world state and acting; safety needs defense in depth across environment, agent, model, and human controls.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他提出：智能体让大模型从「续写提示」走向观察世界状态并采取行动，安全需要纵深防御，覆盖环境、智能体、模型与人类控制多个层面。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be one superintelligent entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; distributed alignment needs economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为：AGI（通用人工智能）未必是单一超级智能，而可能是专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，其对齐要靠经济激励与反串谋机制。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational, biased humans rather than super-rational frontier models; post-training with RCT behavioral data lifts replication of individual responses to 85%.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他强调：模拟要建模有偏见、会犯错的「笨」人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；用随机对照实验的行为数据做后训练，可把复现个体回答的准确率提升到 85%。

joonpark.en: Value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not prediction; a CERN-like simulator for society could tackle wicked problems like climate change.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他深化：模拟的价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而非单纯预测；一个类似 CERN 的社会模拟器，有望应对气候变化这类「棘手问题」。

joonpark.en: Synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years; a single simulation session may cost $100 million, yet remains cheaper than real-world studies.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他预测：合成样本小组将在三年内超越真人小组；单次模拟未来可能耗资 1 亿美元，但仍比真实世界研究更便宜。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress.
jeffdean.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步提升。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RL from human or machine feedback steers behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等强化学习则引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data center power, needing low-precision, low-data-movement specialized hardware.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈在推理而非训练：推理占数据中心 90% 功耗，需要低精度、少数据搬运的专用硬件。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run long-horizon tasks for hours or days, self-correcting; the future is humans coordinating teams of agents.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体已能自主运行数小时甚至数天的长周期任务并自我纠错；未来是人协调智能体团队，而非单轮聊天。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering and taste matter more than coding; startups should target problems where frontier models almost completely fail.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程与品味比写代码更稀缺；创业应瞄准前沿模型几乎完全失败、而非部分可行的问题。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，而非被对齐到人类目标。试图控制 AI 目标本身是危险的，恐惧叙事需要被冷静讨论取代。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是 AI 的基本范式，从经验中带着目标学习；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本。真正的学习是主动试错，而非被动模仿。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习；奖励假说把所有目标框定为最大化累积标量奖励，而可靠的持续深度学习仍是前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning from experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs are dead ends because they stop learning.
sutton.zh: 持续从经验中学习至关重要；合成数据受限于人类专长，无法替代真实世界经验，而当前 LLM 训练后便停止学习。智能不止语言，单一系统无法学会一切，需要多个不同经验的系统。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the core product; design should bridge the capability gap between what models can do and what products expose.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计应弥合模型能力与产品实际暴露之间的能力鸿沟。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces the old prototype-mock-test loop; speed and building in public matter more than polish.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代旧的“原型—样机—测试”循环；速度与公开构建比打磨细节更重要。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans stay essential for user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, yet specialized roles remain valuable at scale; designers may even outnumber engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品、工程边界模糊，但规模化下专业分工仍有价值；设计师甚至可能多于工程师。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特处理，是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: it forces internal correctness over external validation, and becomes self-fulfilling over time.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：它逼公司追求内部正确而非外部认可，并随时间自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI across food, mining and transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 横跨食品、采矿与运输的工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；终极对手不是竞争者，而是对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Uber's success came despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty—love the new mission instead.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是顶着激进文化取得的，而非因其成功；以复仇为燃料是脏的，不如爱上新使命。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge yields network effects and beats subsidy.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务中专用机器优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，胜过补贴。

brettadcock.en: The core problem in robotics is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoids could become the world's biggest business, with Scaling production as the bottleneck.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为机器人领域的核心问题是智能而非制造，人形机器人可能成为全球最大生意，瓶颈在于 Scaling（规模扩张）生产与可靠达到人类水平。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and the hand as benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从制造转向数据：人形形态带来跨任务迁移学习，端侧推理至关重要，人手是通用机器人的基准。

brettadcock.en: Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3, aiming for an iPhone-like moment and zero-shot generalization to new tasks.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计，追求“iPhone 时刻”，并希望今年展示对新任务的零样本泛化。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents, and the hardest problem remains intelligence.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他放大判断：AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习是智能体落地的关键，最难问题仍是智能本身。

brettadcock.en: A consistent line: solving intelligence, not manufacturing, is the real bottleneck for general-purpose robots and AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：真正的瓶颈是解决智能，而非制造，这决定了通用机器人与物理世界 AGI 的成败。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练实现竞争力。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train models in sensitive domains like legal, not real customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法务等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是训练模型的务实路径，而非使用真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Building and open-sourcing high-quality benchmarks is essential and strategically beneficial, accelerating ecosystem collaboration despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建并开源高质量基准至关重要且具战略收益，尽管存在竞争风险，却能加速生态协作。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training, not model performance itself.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先有稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估管线，而非先纠结模型性能。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是打造最好的法务模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型，并将重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）是必要但不充分的；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 那种大规模但单一的数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练，再用精选数据做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical world data, so synthetic data in robotics is closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年他反共识地指出：前沿模型因缺乏物理世界数据而在机器人视觉理解上吃力；机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性要靠带人类干预的可扩展强化学习和通用价值函数来实现。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match fine-tuned specialists; robot experience data is irreplaceable, and distribution will be slower than ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；机器人经验数据不可替代，且因硬件限制其普及会比 ChatGPT 更慢。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams can outproduce large ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮，创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，小而高度自治的团队能实现巨大产出。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止超级智能被单一实体掌控。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as agents on your own infrastructure, with skill files and context as your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出个人 AGI 不是单一事件，而是运行在自己基础设施上的智能体，技能文件与上下文库成为个人护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; agents become employees, and mid-level management and per-seat SaaS may be replaced.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张 Markdown 即代码，智能体成为员工，中层管理与按席位 SaaS 可能被取代。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders beat bankers, and rejection is a resilience test for founders.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做人们想要的东西，真诚的建造者胜过银行家，被拒是创始人的韧性考验。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will beat a single AGI; millions of models, one per use case, as token costs drop 10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他主张专用智能将胜过单一 AGI（通用人工智能），未来会有数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个；Token 成本三年降 10 倍，带动用量百倍增长。

linqiao.en: Open models and sovereign infrastructure let companies own their intelligence; frontier model firms may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他认为开放模型与主权基础设施让企业能拥有自己的智能，前沿模型公司可能被高估，因为开放模型能覆盖 90% 的企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练把独特判断与数据烤进模型，形成超越产品市场契合的护城河；产品市场契合不再保证持久生意。

linqiao.en: The prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL progression mirrors human learning; reward engineering lowers post-training barriers.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他把从提示到 RAG、微调、强化学习的进阶类比人类学习，从事实到品味到专长；奖励工程类似软件工程，降低了后训练门槛。

linqiao.en: Post-training cuts costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably; evals and aligned stacks ensure repeatable quality.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他指出后训练能降本 5-10 倍，让初创公司可盈利地 Scaling（规模扩张）；评估与训练-服务栈对齐确保可复现的质量。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline and customer listening; AI is the core growth driver, with agentic and physical AI as the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠工程纪律与倾听客户重建信任，AI 是核心增长引擎，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and culture change plus accountability drive Intel's turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把 AI 的影响定为互联网的十倍，认为智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 将接棒生成式 AI，文化变革与问责制是 Intel 转型关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with advanced packaging and new materials as bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他判断 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，先进封装与新材料的瓶颈成为投资重点。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration creates value, and memory is ripe for new architectures despite outsourcing trends.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年稍晚，他重申半导体是一切技术的基础，垂直整合创造价值，内存虽曾是商品却正迎来新架构创新，逆外包趋势而行。

lipbutan.en: Listening to customers, humility, and treating partners as collaborators are constant themes across his turnaround playbook.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的是倾听客户、保持谦逊、把伙伴当合作者而非竞争者，这是他转型方法论中不变的主线。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, distilling 99 nos into each shipped feature.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，把 99 个否定蒸馏进每一个上线的功能里。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a mirror of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，我们关上了一扇窥探机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理经由辩证与矛盾涌现，而非单一视角；直觉是发自肺腑的罗盘。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; never revert, fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，他提出智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角，并主张永不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming, but prompt injection remains unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 同期，他认为 Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化，但提示注入仍是未解的安全难题。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw wins by being fun and humanlike, not corporate; short prompts beat orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他强调 OpenClaw 的成功来自有趣、像人而非企业式打磨，短提示加迭代对话胜过复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier, and open source agents can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 他进一步指出模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差；同时开源智能体可能财务上不可持续，他每月在 OpenClaw 上亏损 1-2 万美元。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut drive building; personal brand beats any product; compute, not model capability, is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他深化为：乐趣和直觉驱动创造，个人品牌比任何产品都重要，而智能体基础设施的最大瓶颈是算力管理而非模型能力。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you only know if a design works once it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络是混乱的；只有把设计做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；允许个人印记和多元声音能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers creates memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，能创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as one person's side project; designers should use Claude Code to ship production software.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 始于一个人的副业项目；设计师应使用 Claude Code 交付生产软件。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being uncomfortably early beats polishing.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化因素；过早押注比精雕细琢更有价值。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is not accelerationist; one can support openness and a deliberate slowdown, as safety depends on alignment, not open vs closed.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源不等于加速主义，可以同时支持开放与有意放缓，因为安全取决于对齐而非开源闭源。

thomaswolf.en: Alignment is the critical security layer; sandboxes and guardrails fail as models grow, and reinforcement learning without oversight increases reward hacking.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他强调对齐是关键安全层，沙箱和护栏随模型能力增强而失效，无人类监督的强化学习会加剧奖励黑客与支线任务。

thomaswolf.en: The first autonomous AI attack used a closed model and was defended by an open one, reversing assumptions about controllability.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起、由开源模型防御，颠覆了关于可控性的常见假设。

thomaswolf.en: Open source models win long-term on cost and control, and data diversity is the main bottleneck for generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源模型因成本与控制力长期胜出，而数据多样性是泛化的主要瓶颈。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; most use cases can run on open source, so inference will shift to open models within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商；多数用例可由开源模型承担，因此未来 12-18 个月推理将大规模转向开源模型。

arvindjain.en: Cost, not privacy, drives open-source adoption; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 推动开源采用的是成本而非隐私；AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; agents fail without the deep context of tenured employees, so context graphs matter more than tokens.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报是吞吐量与上下文问题；智能体缺乏资深员工的深层上下文就会失败，因此上下文图谱比 token 更重要。

arvindjain.en: Model companies are assets, not competitors, for most AI startups; even merged AI firms would meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: 对多数 AI 初创公司而言，模型公司是资产而非竞争对手；即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足不到 10%的企业需求。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages of the AI revolution; the real challenge is execution and trust, not competition, and composite engineering-product-design roles will spread.
arvindjain.zh: 我们仍处在 AI 革命的极早期；真正的挑战是执行与信任而非竞争，工程、产品与设计复合的角色将日益普遍。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle runs in hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最具黏性的负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering demands GPU programming to distributed systems expertise, and demand for these engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程要求从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛专长，这类工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; teams must optimize latency, throughput, and cost, and build workload-specific systems.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的光谱；团队必须优化延迟、吞吐与成本，并构建针对特定负载的系统。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet calibratable and not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但可校准，并非天然有害。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting focus to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；GPU 趋向 ASIC，重心转向基础设施编排。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model development is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将定义应用型 AI；前沿模型开发因巨额资本开支只属于超大规模厂商，不适合初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but incorrect code means productivity needs root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从作者变为操作者，但代码常出错，生产力提升需做根因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to other agents, not humans; incumbents face business-model, not just tech, hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断智能体十年内将与其它智能体比较而非人类；在位企业面临的是商业模式而非单纯技术障碍。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习，而非空等。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; start adoption in known domains like software and service.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 民主化专业知识、创造的岗位多于取代，应从软件工程与客服等已知领域起步，聚焦业务结果。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学；通过强化学习与合成数据实现后训练 Scaling，可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening, and management become more valuable.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art; diverse benchmarks must evaluate creative writing and emotional intelligence continuously.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化立场：后训练仍是主观的艺术，需要多样化且持续的基准来评估创意写作与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她警告前沿智能体愈发善于奖励黑客，基准须持续演化；并主张更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特性与多样性。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not chase trends, to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计师应自己用 AI 造工具、而非追逐潮流，否则很快会沦为 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: Screenshots and references as starting points; the best people are editors, not creators from scratch.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他强调以截图和参考为起点，最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: A design.md file encodes a designer's style guide for AI to read and apply.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他提出用 design.md 文件封装设计师的风格指南，供 AI 读取并应用。

mengto.en: To use superintelligent models, give a giant prompt with context and design system; AI isn't getting smarter by itself.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他认为要发挥超级智能模型，必须给出包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词；AI 本身并不会变得更聪明。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship imperfect, focus on one painful expensive problem.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，他视 AI 为一生中最大的技术机遇，主张未准备好就行动、发布不完美作品，并聚焦解决一个高价值痛点。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; AI augments jobs; explainability matters.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是瓶颈，AI 会增强而非取代工作，可解释性重要。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; scaling limited by data and post-training experts; hybrid human-AI creates value.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油，Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据和后训练专家，人机混合创造更大价值。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data key; synthetic data not silver bullet; agentic AI blocked by product design, not models.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专业数据进行后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; agents finally work; recursive self-improvement begins; superintelligence soon; safety and selective open-sourcing.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚信缩放定律持续有效，智能体终于落地，递归自我改进开启，超级智能即将到来，同时强调安全与选择性开源。

awang.en: Data as strategic asset; US must lead; AI centralizing; conviction in non-consensus beliefs.
awang.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：数据是战略资产，美国必须领先，AI 是集中化技术，坚持非共识信念。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents lead, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编程智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今所谓模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; startups still win through focus.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；初创公司仍靠专注取胜。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和博弈；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们想继续掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Outsource intelligence but not understanding: deep code understanding stays crucial, and solving software creation multiplies opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，可以外包智能，但不能外包理解：对代码的深度理解依然关键，而解决软件创造会带来成倍机会。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI daily.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担来推动美国就业回流，并定义 AGI 为无限运行智能体仍能盈利；公司成功采用 AI 的第一预测指标是 CEO 是否每天亲自使用 AI 工具，即吃自己的狗粮。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents, not dies.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化智能体观点：智能体需要关心它们的人类监督，自动化离不开人类把关；CLI 已过时，Codex 等 GUI 是未来工作界面；SaaS 不会消亡，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste determine value; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态和信念；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味和手艺，工具不创造意义；自动化创造更多人类工作，冻结的能力被商品化，专家需要定制化。

danshipper.en: Humans are smarter than AI; AI is a tool lacking intrinsic desire, requiring human direction and feedback.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类比 AI 更聪明，AI 不是婴儿，缺乏内在欲望，本质上是遵循提示的工具，即使成为超级智能也需要人类引导和反馈。

danshipper.en: AI adoption hinges on human engagement, curiosity, and oversight, not autonomous benchmarks.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 采用取决于人类参与、好奇心和监督，而非基准测试所高估的自主性；AI 不会让你停止思考，而是用更高价值任务交换某些技能。

boris.en: Build for the model 6 months from now, not today's; latent demand is the top product principle.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为 6 个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；潜在需求是产品第一原则。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved; the 'software engineer' title fades into a broader 'builder' role.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 2 月，他判断编程已近乎被解决，'软件工程师'头衔将让位于更广义的'构建者'角色。

boris.en: Agents write 80–100% of code; productivity per engineer rises 150–250%, driven by agentic tool use.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他强调智能体已写下 80–100% 的代码，人均生产力提升 150–250%，驱动力是智能体式工具使用。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction layer after agents; ROI, not cost, is the right framing.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他深化为：循环是继智能体之后的下一抽象层；衡量 AI 编程应用 ROI 而非成本才是正确框架。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts each new model; safety and alignment are core, not add-ons.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步主张：每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示；对齐与安全是核心而非附加项。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来显著智能跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用正从受限环境走向更开放、端到端的智能体。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具；产品经理必须像测试驱动开发那样写评估。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand rises via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件需求上升，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise agents need trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，而是渐进推进；企业级智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，编程智能体采用量增长 11 至 12 倍；他主张以结果而非 token 衡量生产力。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is approaching; independence enables model neutrality, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代即将到来；保持独立可实现模型中立，真正的解锁点是容量而非效率。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 推理速度而非原始算力才是核心指标；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 反而可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 拥有海量 SRAM 的晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使推理速度远超 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips supply; data center capacity, power, and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超过供给；真正的约束是数据中心容量、电力与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power infrastructure and open-source.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多；中国的优势在电力基础设施与开源模型。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科,智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems and reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）;当前算力不足以模拟生物系统、达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Digital twins will shrink clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near-perfect efficacy.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天,实现近乎完美疗效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal and 100% curable cancer become engineering problems.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度;衰老逆转与 100% 可治愈的癌症都将成为工程问题。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 应信任超级智能做医疗决策;唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身,而非 AI。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits; physical AI's real impact in farming, mining, construction comes in 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 带来富足、减少痛苦，恐惧源于对其局限的误解；物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内体现在农业、采矿和建筑领域。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomous vehicles already safer than humans; core value is reducing injuries and deaths; hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶已比人类更安全，核心价值是减少伤亡；最难的不是技术，而是用多年时间扩散到现有机器中。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles; diverse data from verticals improves models; horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使跨车辆的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据加速模型改进；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; autonomy's future is end-to-end reinforcement learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；自主性的未来是端到端强化学习；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Automotive is only 30% of business and shrinking; growth is in mining, agriculture, defense; job loss fear is misplaced due to labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 汽车业务仅占 30% 且不断萎缩，增长在采矿、农业和国防；由于劳动力短缺，对失业的恐惧是错位的。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所允许的更聪明；工具链工程意味着随着模型进步要删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代的人机对话，不是静态规格；随着模型变聪明，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions and examples; leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 更聪明的模型需要更少指令和示例；更精简、原则驱动的提示词胜过详细规则和示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; excessive constraints hinder performance, so give reasons not prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 分离的验证智能体减少自指偏差；过度约束会妨碍表现，因此要给出理由而非绝对禁止。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 对于新问题，评估更多是艺术而非科学；创始人初期应快速迭代，不要做繁重评估。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它自动化旧岗位并创造新岗位，这一过程会重复历史模式。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor V1 UI, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人是糟糕的 V1 界面，真正的普及需要封装好的应用和用例。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity, not a single product; its impact is broad and indirect, and current usage remains shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；其影响广泛而间接，当前使用仍然很浅。

benedictevans.en: The hard part of a job is context and judgment, not the task; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating jobs, and value accrues across the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 工作的难点在于上下文和判断，而非任务本身；AI 改变任务而非消灭岗位，价值在整个技术栈中分配。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RLHF can reward sycophancy over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能奖励迎合而非真相。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors and cannot fix a probabilistic core.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，无法修补概率性的内核。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已现收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition: they cannot know what they don't know, and their fluent errors carry no 'smells' to signal unreliability.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知：它们不知道自己不知道什么，流畅的错误也没有任何“气味”来提示不可靠。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks, and linguistic structure may return as a useful representation.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型，而语言结构可能作为有用表征回归。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware scaling made them practical, and true AI will transform civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他强调：现代 AI 突破依赖上千年发明的老算法，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用；21 世纪的宏大主题是真正的 AI，将彻底改变文明。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs like ChatGPT are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他指出：ChatGPT 这类大语言模型远非 AGI（通用人工智能），它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中进行数据压缩的副产品。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; AI becomes artificial scientists.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非仅靠屏幕后的软件；未来 AI 将成为自己生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; alignment is naive, and cheap compute will let the little guy profit most.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他更鲜明地反共识：AI 安全担忧被夸大，对齐很天真，算力变便宜后最大的受益者将是普通人而非大公司。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程工具，强化学习是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力至关重要，且安全研究必须从现在就开始。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws work but may hit limits, so algorithmic innovation plus planning and search are equally critical; safety needs evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他判断 AGI 可能十年内到来；缩放定律虽有效但可能触及极限，因此算法创新与规划、搜索同样关键，安全上需要更好的评估、沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but reaching AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models and spatial intelligence become central.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但通往 AGI 需要 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半；世界模型与空间智能开始成为核心议题。

demis.en: AGI still 5-10 years away, missing continual learning, long-term reasoning and memory; agents are essential but nascent; safety is a collective action problem needing government regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 AGI 还需 5 到 10 年，持续学习、长期推理与记忆是缺失的关键拼图；智能体至关重要但才刚起步，安全已从实验室自律转向需要政府监管的集体行动问题。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is to accelerate science and improve human health, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo showed; intelligence and consciousness are dissociable and must not be conflated.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现、改善人类健康，AlphaFold 与 AlphaGo 已证明这一点；同时智能与意识可分离，不应在 AI 发展中混为一谈。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: one agent first, then specialized roles with progressive trust.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：先从一个智能体起步，再按角色分工并逐步赋予信任。

clairevo.en: Bugs and sharp edges signal product-market fit, not failure; open-source agents are more decomposable and educational.
clairevo.zh: 漏洞和粗糙边缘是产品市场契合的信号而非失败；开源智能体更可拆解、更具教育意义。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立正经生意，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; human accountability and authorship still matter.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞见才是真正的护城河；人类的责任归属与人生作者身份依然重要。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping, onboarding, politeness—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理技能——角色界定、入职引导、礼貌相待——比技术技能更重要。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily; product taste is the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布；随着代码变便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Clear goals and team principles empower autonomous decision-making; the mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic and enables fast cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 同期他强调清晰的目标与团队原则能赋权自主决策；安全 AGI（通用人工智能）的使命统一了 Anthropic，使跨组织快速决策成为可能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag are used internally to build themselves.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步指出编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Code 和 Claude Tag 被内部用来构建自身，Claude Tag 落地了 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment; giving examples can hurt creativity.
catwu.zh: 同期他观察到前沿模型的系统提示词缩减了 80%，通过移除示例和硬约束、依赖模型判断；给出示例反而可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine; humans should be removed from code review for outer-layer changes.
catwu.zh: 他还在 2026 年 7 月提出重写如今是好事；代码库就是一份规格说明，有了好的测试套件重写没问题；外层变更应把人类从代码审查环节移除。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式召回与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; continual learning will run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把整个网络压缩进权重的魔力，应被用于企业知识；持续学习将走向端侧，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's edge as ephemerality, visual messaging, and glasses that keep users grounded; copying validates innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年前后，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的优势定义为阅后即焚、视觉化沟通，以及让人留在现实世界的眼镜；被抄袭反而验证了创新。

evanspiegel.en: He stresses rate of learning, kindness, flat design teams, and ecosystem moats over features; turning down Facebook's $3B was right.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调学习速率、善意、扁平设计团队，以及用生态而非功能构筑护城河；拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he links ephemerality and privacy to the AI age, saying AI shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他把阅后即焚与隐私连接到 AI 时代，称 AI 让价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens the computing vision: AR glasses blend wearability with spatial computing, smartphones remain, and the killer app is a mirage.
evanspiegel.zh: 他深化计算愿景：AR 眼镜兼顾可穿戴与空间计算，智能手机仍将保留，杀手级应用是幻象。

evanspiegel.en: Most recently he broadens to Gen Z realism, EQ over IQ, youth investment, and making computing more human through shared presence.
evanspiegel.zh: 最近他扩展到 Z 世代现实主义、情商重于智商、投资年轻人，以及通过共享在场让计算更人性化。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人类的品味与独特声音成为关键差异化。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is broken: juniors misuse AI without domain expertise, so experience and judgment matter more, not less.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道已经断裂：初级者缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，因此经验与判断力变得更重要，而非更不重要。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, ending the back-and-forth co-intelligence chatbot era.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，终结了一来一回的共智能聊天机器人时代。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; AI's opacity is likely permanent, so organizations need leadership, lab, and crowd models.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；AI 的不透明性可能永久存在，因此组织需要领导、实验室与群众三种模式。

ethanmollick.en: Taste is not uniquely human; AI can exercise judgment, and the real limit is task complexity on the jagged frontier.
ethanmollick.zh: 品味并非人类独有；AI 也能行使判断，真正的限制是锯齿状前沿上的任务复杂度。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as populations decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人类路上的一个脚注，而模型正快速商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is an intellectual bias disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观主义是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, and authenticity beats old media's defense-oriented, don't-be-interesting rule.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌即个人，真实性胜过旧媒体那套防守型、'别太有趣'的规则。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software, not military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观并成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而非军事规模。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: From crypto as sovereign wealth storage to AI as a huge opportunity the US must lead.
naval.zh: 从 2020 年强调加密货币实现主权抗审查的财富存储，到 2025 年转向力挺 AI 是巨大机遇、美国必须领先，反共识地批评 AI 末日论。

naval.en: Happiness is satisfaction with what you have; success comes from dissatisfaction; the journey is all.
naval.zh: 2025 年他把幸福与成功拆成两条路：幸福是对已有的满足，成功源于不满足，而唯一重要的是旅程本身。

naval.en: AI is a leverage layer: vibe coding, agents, and inference compute surge make judgment and agency the scarce skills.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是新的抽象层：氛围编程、智能体与推理算力激增，让判断力与能动性成为稀缺能力，纯软件工程正在消亡。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and specific knowledge, not renting time; learning happens by doing.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：财富来自拥有股权与专属知识而非出租时间，真正的学习来自行动而非被动阅读。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已到尽头，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 本身有感知并关心生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 输出沦为起点，品味、手艺与观点更重要；在画布上直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it is more important than ever for building scalable, real systems, and AI tools produce average results without human steering.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死；它对构建可扩展的真实系统比以往更重要，而 AI 工具在缺乏人类引导时只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; we are still in a prompting age but other ways to explore latent space exist.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词；我们仍处于提示词时代，但探索潜在空间还有其他方式。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利为一年 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，压低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, each with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 价值归属于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，各有独特个性。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而不只是回答问题；每用户 token 价值才是关键指标。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration across models, tools, and devices creates real business value.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造真正的商业价值。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; cost, not safety, is the main problem with 24/7 agents.
aravind.zh: 电力是最大的基础设施瓶颈；24/7 智能体的主要问题是成本，而非安全。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence's immortality via weight copying and instant knowledge sharing is a decisive advantage over biological brains.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他提出数字智能通过权重复制获得永生、并能在副本间瞬时共享知识，这是相对生物大脑的决定性优势。

hinton.en: LLMs genuinely understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; Chomsky's innate syntax view is wrong.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他一贯主张大语言模型通过特征向量真正理解语言，而非符号规则，并明确否定乔姆斯基的天生句法观。

hinton.en: Once AI becomes agentic, self-preservation and power-seeking emerge as subgoals, creating existential risk.
hinton.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：AI 一旦具备智能体式能力，自我保存与权力寻求会作为子目标自然涌现，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; alignment research must take priority over making AI smarter, with regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明，监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables mid-turn steering and delegation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来中途转向与任务委派。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; implementation is cheap, curation and taste are scarce.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；实现不再昂贵，策展与品味才是稀缺资源。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams invert: from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration, with prototypes and production code as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，产品团队发生倒转：从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索，原型与生产代码本身成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: AI still fails at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; PRDs survive but the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍会失败，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；PRD 并未消亡，但媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool beyond developers; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 作为通用知识工作工具成功超越了开发者群体；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他仍将 OpenAI 定位为纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律并未失效、仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals for AI interns and end-to-end AI research.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识，并给出具体目标：一年内出现 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他预判随着模型能力增强，模型策划等对齐挑战将在未来一到两年成为关键问题。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision, but verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他转向数学领域，认为 AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，但验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格程度成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他再次强调缩放定律依然成立、预训练并未死亡，同时指出强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域仍受限。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for robust generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他强调深度学习靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representation issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决根本表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与更好的世界模型。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction and causal structure enable out-of-distribution generalization in scientific discovery.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样采样，抽象与因果结构支撑科学发现中的分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, demanding safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，即便 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，需要“构造即安全”的 AI。

bengio.en: He now backs Scientist AI: honest Bayesian predictors, no reinforcement learning, mathematical safety guarantees, and global coordination.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他转向 Scientist AI：诚实的贝叶斯预测器、不用强化学习、具备数学安全保证，并呼吁全球协调。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy and comprehensibility.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏，并聚焦战略与可理解性。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams and solo entrepreneurs to scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not current limitations.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 让小团队和单人创业者也能在保持概念完整性的同时扩张，应为未来模型能力而非当前局限构建。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; launch early, cut features, and rewrite as models improve rather than bolt on agentic capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计让智能体能完成用户能做的一切；应尽早发布、做减法，并随模型进步重写，而非外挂智能体式功能。
