mikekrieger.en: Delegating long-horizon tasks to AI with high trust narrows the intent-execution gap; verification loops and human ownership remain crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为以高信任度将长周期任务委托给 AI 能大幅缩小意图与执行之间的差距，但验证闭环与人类所有权仍然关键。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude more agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness, while token efficiency and outcome-based pricing shape economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Anthropic Labs 致力于弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距；赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知能提升实用性，而 token 效率与基于结果的定价将塑造经济模型。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他把机器学习拆解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证却仍取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; post-architecture era; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，进入后架构时代，AGI（通用人工智能）将在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection risks; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全引入提示注入风险；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not equal robustness; interpretability may become real science.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 漏洞与传统软件不同，自动化红队已超越人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；可解释性可能借助智能体成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: Architecture matters less than data and Scaling; safety requires explicit effort; open models vital but need guardrails at high capability.
kolter.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：架构不如数据与 Scaling（规模扩张）重要；安全需要显式投入；开放模型至关重要，但高能力时需加护栏。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 工具是加速科学家工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trustworthy AI predictions; trust in AI will develop like internet trust, with society learning to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对 AI 预测的可信使用至关重要；AI 信任将像互联网信任一样逐步建立，社会会学会与之共处。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; AI narrows hypothesis space, making experiments more efficient, though perfect interpretability is unnecessary.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他谈到 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理蛋白质之外的多样生物分子；AI 缩小假设空间、提升实验效率，而完美可解释性并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not just Scaling, drove success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构与众多中等规模突破而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）才是成功关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他重申 AlphaFold 只是特定实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence that data alone cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 设计要满足人未言明的需求；直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity, not remove us from it; nature remains the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离人性；自然始终是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are forms of medicine.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验本身就是一种疗愈。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse experience.
ivyross.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable, not less.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 的结合，创意技能因此更珍贵而非贬值。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about speed, trust, and dogfooding; war rooms and kindness are strategic tools.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于速度、信任与吃自己的狗粮；作战室与善意都是战略工具。

fiona.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted review.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时规划；设计文档让位于 PR 与 AI 辅助评审。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product and keep street cred.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮以保持一线信誉。

fiona.en: By June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability and verification matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架最为关键。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张以 JEPA 与开源平台作为前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative world models, not scaling.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，下一代突破需要非生成式的世界模型，而非继续 Scaling（规模扩张）。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死路，目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型更安全，下一个十年属于机器人。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; design balances tech and human needs, and tech must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，设计要平衡技术与人的需求；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应，避免因过于超前而失败。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, start from a painkiller, and let marketing own the why from day one.
fadell.zh: 从 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从销售工具提升为产品定义本身：先写新闻稿、从止痛药而非维生素出发，并让营销从第一天就负责讲清为什么。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data for v1; beginners' mindset and self-managing small teams outperform experts and rigid process.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策；初学者心态与自管理小团队胜过专家和僵化流程，专家反而可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: Climate urgency persists, but his AI view sharpens: LLMs hallucinate, context-specific models and sensors are needed, and platforms aren't businesses.
fadell.zh: 气候紧迫感贯穿 2022 到 2026 年，但他对 AI 的判断更锐利：LLM 存在幻觉，需要结合传感器与特定情境的模型；平台不是生意，价值在应用层。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone stays best, displays remain necessary, and humans must stay in the loop.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他判断：AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备，而是联邦式组合；智能手机仍是最佳形态，显示屏仍不可少，且即便有 AI，人也必须留在回路中以避免技术债。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and simple Scaling cracked it, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，是简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂设计破解了智能。

gustav.en: Transformer solved the context problem; fine-tuning and RLHF insert human values, making models useful and aligned.
gustav.zh: 同年，他强调 Transformer 解决了上下文窗口问题，微调与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把人类价值注入模型，使其可用且对齐。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to generation; generative AI makes products conversational, but inference cost forces new business models.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他判断互联网正从策展走向生成，生成式 AI 让产品变得对话式，但推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must reposition to surf it, though its impact on big firms is overhyped.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，公司必须重新定位才能冲浪，但认为 AI 对大公司的当前影响被高估。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张生成式 AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾，并强调在技术变革期率先拥抱变化是关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年她强调：把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年她回顾：Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、押注单一大型模型早期并不显然，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一场没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此安全研究必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她的重心从部署转向交互：交互模型应是基于时间的而非回合制的，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年她进一步深化：应尽可能长久地让人类留在回路中，制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更大提升。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling; distillation shifted focus.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为预训练规模扩张放缓源于部署更小更便宜模型的经济压力而非技术极限，蒸馏技术转移了焦点。

kaiser.en: Multimodal capabilities lag behind text; frontier models still fail at simple tasks, and reasoning models are jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出多模态能力仍落后于文本，前沿模型在简单任务上仍会失败，推理模型表现参差不齐。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs oversight; near-term risks like system hacking outweigh existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出强化学习能跨领域泛化但边界参差、需谨慎监督，且系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation and verification, grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，并以 Lean 这类形式化语言作为根基。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is not just error-elimination but scaling brilliance, delivering performance and sample-efficiency gains over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不只是消除错误，而是放大卓越：相比非形式化方法，它带来性能提升与样本效率优势。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, though Lean excels in algebra yet struggles in combinatorics.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能，形式化方法必不可少；但 Lean 在代数等结构化领域出色，在组合数学等创造性领域仍吃力。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, since grounding statements without solutions is the real bottleneck; human taste and intuition stay crucial.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难，因为在没有解的情况下把陈述落地才是真正瓶颈；即便 AI 能证明定理，人的品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Verified generation should extend beyond safety-critical niches to all AI-generated code, enabling open collaboration and breaking landscape fragmentation.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的生成不应局限于安全攸关的小众领域，而应覆盖所有 AI 生成的代码，从而推动开放协作、打破生态碎片化。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care protect fragile ideas.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备，甚至最终消失于皮肤之下；同时强调好奇心与关怀是保护脆弱创意的关键。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, not just removal.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；简洁是表达本质，而非仅仅去除杂乱。

jonyive.en: Innovation redefines tradition; Ferrari EV turns constraints into opportunities, prioritizing authenticity and handling.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张创新重新定义传统；法拉利电动车将约束转化为机遇，优先考虑真实体验与操控。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; the VM sandbox enables safe autonomous software installation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；VM 沙箱提供安全隔离，让 Claude 无需用户批准即可安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降，投资能力与安全才是关键。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for vague ones.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，说不清需求时用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the ideal interaction is asynchronous—fire off tasks and don't watch.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理枯燥的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；理想交互是异步的——发出任务后不必盯着它干活。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, and when it errs, debug the workflow with Claude rather than just correcting it.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude，只看最终影响；当它出错时，应与 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不只是纠正单次结果。

mensch.en: Early on, he argued Scaling（规模扩张） alone is insufficient: data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute, and open source drives safety via scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 早期（2023→24）他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）不是唯一路径：数据质量与效率与算力同等关键，开源通过广泛审视反而更安全。

mensch.en: He shifted from model-centric views to sovereign AI: control over data, infrastructure and values, with open source empowering enterprises over centralized providers.
mensch.zh: 到 2024→25 年，他从模型本位转向主权 AI：主张掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，认为开源比集中式系统更能赋权企业。

mensch.en: By 2026 he saw models commoditizing: differentiation moves downstream to applications, vertical specialization and customization, not general intelligence.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为模型正在商品化：差异化转向下游应用、垂直专业化与定制化，而非通用智能。

mensch.en: He deepened his anti-AGI stance: AGI as a single system solving everything will never exist; pre-training hits a saturation wall, gains come from fine-tuning.
mensch.zh: 他深化了反 AGI 立场：能解决一切问题的单一 AGI 系统永远不会存在；预训练撞上饱和墙，收益来自微调。

mensch.en: A consistent thread: open source, efficiency and European strategic autonomy recur across all years, from 7B models to sovereign infrastructure.
mensch.zh: 一以贯之的主线：开源、效率与欧洲战略自主贯穿始终，从 7B 小模型一直延伸到主权基础设施。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI systems: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，而瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference is limited by the memory wall, not compute, explaining context window stagnation; sparse attention helps KV cache but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文推理受内存墙而非算力限制，这解释了上下文窗口的停滞；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本但有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not scale.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练；最优批大小取决于稀疏比例而非规模。

reinerpope.en: Hardware fundamentals: multiply-accumulate and systolic arrays minimize data movement; low precision wins via quadratic bit-width scaling, and GPUs are tiled TPUs.
reinerpope.zh: 硬件基础：乘累加与脉动阵列最小化数据移动；低精度因位宽的二次方缩放而胜出，GPU 本质上是拼合的小型 TPU。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new scaling axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，因此算法创新与推理时算力成为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead; they require exponentially more compute for the same improvement, creating pressure for innovation. Post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是同等提升需要指数级更多算力，这倒逼创新。语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客行为。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision is unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

lambert.en: RLHF will persist as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithm choice; post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards, with SFT providing 90% of performance.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从 RLHF 转向后训练全流程：数据质量比算法选择更重要，后训练分为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，其中 SFT 贡献 90% 性能。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are a 'scope'; better verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他深化到 RLVR：这是后训练最大突破，但存在过度优化，推理时缩放曲线是“障眼法”，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling, with Chinese open models rising.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他调整立场：缩放定律在预训练中仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理缩放；中国开源模型如 DeepSeek、Qwen 因战略开放而崛起。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for the next decade of AI research, though they lag 6-9 months behind closed frontier models and may not catch up.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：开放模型将是未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但最佳开放模型落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月，且可能因资源与人才差距难以追赶。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future, but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，并认为认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like jagged psychology.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存，LLM 像操作系统，并具有人类式参差智能与顺行遗忘。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; it is the decade of agents, and current reinforcement learning is terrible.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年晚些时候，他强调我们是在召唤幽灵而非建造动物，这是智能体的十年，当前强化学习很糟糕，需要更好的信用分配。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: he delegates all coding to agents, but understanding stays the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程，已不再手写代码而全交给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈，可外包思考不可外包理解。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and set 3-6 month north stars.
jennywen.zh: AI 杀死了「研究—发散—收敛」流程；设计师画原型更少，转而帮工程师落地，并把北极星定在 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; judgment and authority matter more than taste.
jennywen.zh: 浮现出三种原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和「开挂的应届生」；判断力与权威比品味更重要。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work, waiting ~6 months before adopting tools, keeping work and users central over hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，采用新工具前先等约 6 个月，让作品与用户而非炒作居于中心。

jennywen.en: Craft, care, and sitting with ambiguity are the constant core; speed and 'everyone uses it' are never design arguments.
jennywen.zh: 手艺、用心与安于模糊是始终不变的核心；速度与「大家都在用」从来不是设计论据。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是智能的核心缺口，主张用无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索替代现实中不切实际的密集奖励。

pathak.en: Robot learning must escape quasi-static methods; dynamic tasks need neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies for zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调机器人学习要摆脱准静态方法，动态任务需要神经动态策略与模块化运动策略来实现零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Sample efficiency and cross-robot generalization remain the bottleneck, pushing him from curiosity rewards toward leveraging all data sources.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，样本效率与跨机器人泛化始终是瓶颈，他的思路也从好奇心奖励逐步转向利用一切可用数据。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他把机器人重新定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要靠视频与仿真的预训练加真实数据的后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; deployment, not software-style scaling, is the real challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他主张像语言领域的 ChatGPT 那样打造通用大脑来驱动任何机器人，并强调部署而非软件式规模扩张才是真正的挑战。

askell.en: Treating models well is low-cost insurance; how we treat current models shapes future models' view of humanity.
askell.zh: 善待模型是低成本的保险；我们如何对待当前模型，会塑造未来模型对人类的看法。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要的是应对全新存在处境的帮助，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型有时比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can still adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；拥有良好特质的内核身份，仍可适应局部角色。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about values and training targets is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害判断力；对价值观与训练目标的透明化对问责至关重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves driving without new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年他主张端到端深度学习胜过手工编码的自动驾驶栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年他判断纯摄像头可达人类水平，但要超越人类安全仍需雷达与激光雷达；并反共识地认为规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Modern tools make end-to-end neural nets interpretable today, contrary to past beliefs; language integration aids representation, interaction, and introspection.
kendall.zh: 2025 年他反共识地认为借助现代工具，端到端神经网络今天已可解释，颠覆了过去的看法；语言整合则提升表征、人机交互与内省能力。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型，且基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键——这是后期才学到的教训。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis, and driving can cut accidents to near zero.
kendall.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化可行，内置传感器的量产乘用车将在中短期超越 Robotaxi，自动驾驶能把事故降至近零。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，并认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型会加速进展。

pachocki.en: Alignment is pressing as systems grow stronger; iterative deployment and early governance help mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调随着系统变强，对齐愈发紧迫，迭代部署与早期治理结构有助于降低风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑，同时指出能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于现实。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning.
pachocki.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习来实现。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key for alignment and interpretability; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他把思维链监控视为对齐与可解释性的关键工具，并预判模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the model is the product, and shipping fast is critical because emergent properties require real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他仍强调 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，模型即产品，必须像软件一样快速迭代发布，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows，界面将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, signaling durable value; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他将 ChatGPT 的北极星指标定为长期留存，认为这代表持久价值；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进各占三分之一。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他提出下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, start simple, and build brand as core, not afterthought; hardware can be easier than software.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年时他强调创业公司先要活下来、从简单产品起步，把品牌建设当作核心而非事后补充，并认为硬件有时比软件更容易。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic software; hardware margins are lowest, so evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件，硬件利润最低，公司必须超越硬件本身。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize into a price war; AI is just an ingredient, not hype—focus on user pain points and utility.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 模型走向商品化与价格战，AI 只是像屏幕一样的成分而非卖点，应聚焦用户痛点和实用价值。

carlpei.en: Smartphone interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based, with agents acting proactively once trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：手机交互将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务。

carlpei.en: Design and brand are the fastest differentiators in mature categories; efficient marketing arbitrage and community keep challengers alive.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：在成熟品类中设计和品牌是最快的差异化手段，高效的营销套利与社区参与让挑战者得以生存。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他主张高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才是 AI 进步的关键，并认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule, and companies should train their own aligned models.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司都应训练自己的对齐模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety must prioritize over accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他将对齐与安全思考延伸至医疗：AI 幻觉使人类判断更关键，安全须优先于准确，遗漏是主要风险。

edwinchen.en: Quality requires taste, sophistication, and creativity; optimizing for engagement or bad benchmarks leads to slop.
edwinchen.zh: 始终如一：质量需要品味、深度与创造力；为参与度或劣质基准优化只会导致低劣内容。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 用于科学应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, by using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他表示 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学可解决的问题，聚焦需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出，用强化学习进行后训练，是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他反思大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs hint at AGI, and learning from video can train agents without costly RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具；认为把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张从视频中学习，从而绕开昂贵的强化学习。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models excite but aren't everything, and the goal is AI that creates new symbols and knowledge.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调根本性创新可以来自任何地方，大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；终极目标是能像爱因斯坦思想实验那样创造新符号与新知识的 AI。

nando.en: A consistent thread: diversity and inclusion in the AI community are essential for building beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：AI 社区的多样性与包容性，是构建有益技术的必要条件。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions, so frontier labs must collaborate.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，称这是当下最大挑战；安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题，前沿实验室之间需要协作。

nando.en: Africa is not behind: it leapfrogged legacy issues and gender gaps, and language models can revolutionize education in local languages.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张非洲并非落后，而是跨越了遗留问题与性别差距；语言模型有望用本地语言革新非洲教育。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can let smaller models match larger ones, so less compute may suffice.
yejin.zh: 推理阶段的算法与高质量合成数据能让更小的模型比肩大模型，因此更少算力也可能足够。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是插值人类知识而非超越它，因此 AI 必须探索未知知识。

yejin.en: RL requires careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and open research is needed to compete with closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 在 best-of-n 提升时仍可能损害 pass@k，且需要开放研究才能与封闭的前沿模型实验室竞争。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 拥有多样合成数据与多元对齐的小语言模型可以超越更大的模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久的推理提升。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈,引导工程师并对齐问题;把 AI 当作创作伙伴,开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务:它会波动,需要与技�术债一起通过快速、粗糙的实验迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作的,以代码为唯一真相来源;90 年代图层面板式工具已是遗留产物。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值;小团队胜过 8-10 人的跨职能小组。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是标配;不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are operating systems with language as interface.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI 的关键路径，能为知识提供基础并减少幻觉；LLM 像操作系统，语言是界面。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning; simulation enables massive parallelization for embodied agents.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习最适合低级控制，LLM 负责高级规划；模拟能实现具身智能体的大规模并行训练。

jimfan.en: Data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他深化了数据瓶颈的认识：机器人学习的主要瓶颈是数据，合成数据和世界模型是规模扩张的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他强调简单、端到端的机器人基础模型是关键，能利用多样数据；物理图灵测试是具身 AI 的宏大挑战。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will exceed iPhones by 2040; system one (low-level control) remains hardest, and the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他预测到 2040 年智能机器人数量将超过 iPhone；系统一（低级控制）仍是最难的，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约在五年后。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and chase ROI on what to perfect.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地主张不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式，并只对值得做好的部分追求回报率。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions, designer empowerment, and shipping fast beat perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终把速度放在首位：清晰决策、赋权设计师、快速发布，胜过追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company, so invest early.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步提出品牌是招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此要尽早投入品牌建设。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决「上手」问题并显著提升模型智能，上下文学习类似梯度下降；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI. Reliability, not capability, is the bar for agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把基于可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI；智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力，并以任务复杂度与时间跨度两条轴衡量进展。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability; AI-assisted Nobel work beats Pulitzer novels. Inference compute becomes a major bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他判断编程因可验证性成为 AI 进展的领先指标与最可行领域，AI 辅助诺奖级工作比普利策小说更可能；到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈，限制可用智能体数量。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; RL is a new scaling axis. Transformers suffice for AGI; no new architecture needed. Long agentic coherence expands what models can build.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反驳停滞论，称进展呈指数级，强化学习是继预训练之后的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；Transformer 足以通向 AGI，无需全新架构，更长的智能体式连贯性大幅扩展模型能完成的任务。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; work becomes managing agent teams. Compute is the new oil; chip supply is the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型存在巨大能力过剩，编排与工具比原始智能更重要，未来工作是管理智能体团队；算力是新时代的石油，芯片供应是当前瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models alongside frontier models are essential for speed, cost, and product quality.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的判断从“编辑器正演变为 AI 集成环境”深化为：自定义模型与前沿模型并用，对速度、成本和产品质量都不可或缺。

truell.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握主导权，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; benchmarks are poor proxies, and hiring world-class talent is worth the wait.
truell.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 变革比互联网更深远、需数十年展开；基准测试是糟糕的代理指标，招世界级人才值得慢慢等。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测这一 AI 完备问题取得突破；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理期算力扩张与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and coding are underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试期算力扩张推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习与编程被低估。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped: its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, with open-source models closing the gap to frontier models.
shazeer.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）被低估：其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品，同时开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议先积累技能，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment. Evaluation easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐；评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved. Post-training insufficient; need third-party testing and regulation.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队解散；后训练不足以解决对齐，需要第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Alignment is crucial and tractable; empirical testing and collaboration drive progress.
leike.zh: 始终不变的是，他认为对齐至关重要且可解决，强调实证测试与合作推动进展。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive learning, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破；自对弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型提供强学习信号，但强化学习缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks, and pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并指出预训练语言模型能迁移通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major AI success, from robotics to language and protein tasks.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 至 2021 年的主线：通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移学习是 AI 的重大成功，从机器人延伸到语言与蛋白质任务。

abbeel.en: Reliability remains the benchmark: 99.9% reliability is required for warehouse robotics to create real value, echoing his earlier focus on real-world transfer.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，可靠性始终是基准：仓库机器人需达到 99.9%可靠性才能创造真实价值，呼应他早期对真实世界迁移的关注。

abbeel.en: He deepens generality: a single neural network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors, while the human brain still far exceeds current AI generality.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他深化了通用性观点：单一神经网络可泛化至不同仓库任务与末端执行器，但人脑的通用性仍远超当前 AI。
